why_ai: Underwriting judgement and licensed loan officers protect parts of the work, but automated underwriting, verification and document AI already absorb much of the file production.
why_clarity: A saleable loan is defined by the investor's guide and recurs millions of times a year, though defects surface in QC and repurchases months later.
why_digital: Work starts from documents and data and runs on screens, while closings, signings and many retail loan officer relationships stay local.

why_ai: Hedge and execution calls are high-stakes under volatile markets, but rate sheets, best execution and coverage arithmetic automate.
why_clarity: Locks resolve within weeks and hedge results are marked daily, against well-understood methods.
why_digital: Prices, locks, trades and reports are electronic, and advisors serve lenders remotely.

why_ai: Servicing is regulated and the owner stays accountable, but payment processing and reporting are already automated at scale.
why_clarity: Servicing follows investor guides and Regulation X at huge volume, though MSR assumptions are tested only over rate cycles.
why_digital: Loan and payment data in, statements and reporting out, with some borrower contact still by phone.

why_ai: Targeting and outreach are data work AI does well, though a trusted loan officer still closes many recaptures.
why_clarity: Recapture is countable within weeks of a payoff, but which signal predicts a move is still debated.
why_digital: Servicing data drives digital campaigns, with conversion through loan officers by phone.

why_ai: The owner remains accountable to agencies and regulators for borrower treatment, but loan-level monitoring automates.
why_clarity: Servicing rules are codified and recur at volume, though harm from bad decisions surfaces in audits months later.
why_digital: Loan-level activity files and reports reviewed remotely; subservicers are chosen on contract and audit.

why_ai: Matching and checking documents is routine work that document AI substitutes directly.
why_clarity: Each document either matches the closing package and investor rules or it does not, thousands of times a month.
why_digital: Recorded instruments and wet-ink notes still start on paper, but checking and delivery happen on screens.

why_ai: Rebuttals involve judgement against an agency counterparty, but sampling, classification and drafting automate.
why_clarity: QC follows the Selling Guide's checklist on every sampled file, though agency outcomes arrive months later.
why_digital: Loan files and agency notices in, findings and rebuttals out, all electronic and often outsourced.

why_ai: Manual credit judgement on non-standard income and accountable underwriting keep experienced people central.
why_clarity: Each buyer sets its own rules and loan performance on unconventional income takes years to read.
why_digital: Statements and returns analysed on screens, sold through brokers and aggregator relationships.

why_ai: The underwriter signs the approval the lender defends, but calculation and condition review automate.
why_clarity: Underwriting follows the Selling Guide file after file, though defects show up only in later QC.
why_digital: PDF files in, conditions and approvals out, much of it done remotely or by contract underwriters.

why_ai: Third-party data connections replace manual verification directly.
why_clarity: A component either validates in automated underwriting or it does not, on every file.
why_digital: Payroll and bank data in, verification reports out, bought by API.

why_ai: The compliance officer stays accountable, but field checks against a published specification automate fully.
why_clarity: Every field passes or fails published edits, on every record, every year.
why_digital: Origination data in, filings out on a federal platform.

why_ai: Clients trust a named advisor with their rate risk, but coverage models and execution automate, so the forecast record is the defence.
why_clarity: Daily forecasts resolve against lock outcomes within weeks, using established hedging methods.
why_digital: Pipeline and market data in, position reports and trades out, delivered remotely to lenders nationwide.

why_ai: Rating-agency acceptance keeps accountable reviewers in the loop, but re-underwriting checklists are what document AI automates.
why_clarity: Every loan is graded A to D against published criteria at volume, though grade accuracy shows only in deal performance.
why_digital: Loan files and tapes in, grades and reports out, much of it delivered by offshore review teams.

why_ai: Counsel-directed analysis and expert testimony in enforcement keep trusted economists central.
why_clarity: Regression methods are standard but each lender's market and model differ, and outcomes depend on regulators.
why_digital: Loan data in, analyses and reports out, engaged through counsel.

why_ai: Auditors and lenders rely on a named valuer's mark, and brokered sales run on relationships, though modelling automates.
why_clarity: Marks follow established cash-flow methods each quarter, but whether they were right shows only at sale or over years.
why_digital: Tapes in, marks and bid analyses out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Contributed loan-level data across most of the market is a moat that AI makes more valuable.
why_clarity: Monthly datasets are produced the same way each cycle and checked against servicer submissions.
why_digital: Servicer data in, datasets and research out, sold by licence.

why_ai: Compliance warranties keep accountable content teams, but rule maintenance and form generation automate.
why_clarity: Each package passes or fails defined tests, though new state rules need interpretation.
why_digital: Rules and loan data in, document packages out through software integrations.

why_ai: Lenders buy the consultants' judgement and network, while benchmark production automates.
why_clarity: Benchmarks recur on fixed definitions, though advice is judged by results months later.
why_digital: Contributed data in, reports and advice out, with some on-site consulting.

why_ai: Statutory authority and accountable officials make counterparty decisions consequential and human.
why_clarity: Eligibility tests are codified, but counterparty failure is rare and known only in stress.
why_digital: Financial submissions and loan data reviewed on screens, with on-site operational reviews.

why_ai: Licensing and enforcement authority sit with accountable public officials.
why_clarity: Examination procedures are codified, but whether supervision prevented harm is rarely measurable.
why_digital: Call reports and files reviewed digitally, with some on-site examinations.

why_ai: Credit officers carry accountability for counterparty exposure, and fraud detection needs judgement.
why_clarity: Line monitoring is routine and daily, though counterparty failures are rare and slow to label.
why_digital: Funding and collateral data in, credit decisions out, with relationship management in person.

why_ai: Seller scoring and purchase review are data-heavy tasks that automate.
why_clarity: Every purchased loan is reviewed against the same guide, with performance known within a year.
why_digital: Loan files and performance data reviewed on screens across a national seller base.

why_ai: Institutional standing carries weight in policy debates, but chartbook production automates.
why_clarity: Policy research topics change and their value is rarely measured.
why_digital: Public data in, published analysis out.

why_ai: Members join for relationships and collective bargaining, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Programme value depends on negotiated deals that differ each year.
why_digital: Programmes delivered online, with in-person member events.
